description:
Elite Google Ads & Microsoft (Bing) Advertising Expert Wanted (High-Performance PPC Manager)



This is NOT an entry-level PPC position.



We are looking for a true Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing) expert with a long, verifiable history of producing exceptional ROI through strategic campaign management, relentless optimization, and data-driven decision making.



HYROS EXPERIENCE for campaign integration will be essential



If your experience is simply "I've managed Google Ads before," this position is not for you.



We are looking for someone who lives and breathes paid search marketing and understands that every advertising dollar should be treated like it came out of their own pocket.



About Us



We are a rapidly growing e-commerce company selling premium products to highly targeted professional markets. We are committed to scaling aggressively but only through disciplined, measurable advertising that consistently produces profitable results.



We believe advertising success comes from continuous optimization—not "set it and forget it" campaign management.



What You'll Be Responsible For



You will have complete responsibility for planning, managing, optimizing, and scaling our paid search advertising across:



Google Ads

Microsoft Advertising (Bing)



Your primary objective is simple:



Generate the maximum number of profitable conversions while minimizing wasted advertising spend.



This position requires someone who constantly monitors performance, identifies changing trends, and quickly adapts campaigns before small problems become expensive ones.



You should be obsessed with improving:



Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)

Conversion Rate

Click-Through Rate (CTR)

Impression Share

Quality Score

Search Term Quality

Overall account efficiency

What We're Looking For



We want someone who can demonstrate years of consistent success managing substantial advertising budgets.



You should be able to provide examples of campaigns that produced measurable improvements in:



Revenue growth

Lower acquisition costs

Increased ROAS

Improved conversion rates

Better lead quality

Successful account turnarounds



You should possess advanced knowledge of:



Search Campaigns

Performance Max

Shopping Campaigns

Dynamic Search Ads

Remarketing

Audience Segmentation

Keyword Research

Match Type Strategy

Negative Keyword Expansion

Conversion Tracking

Google Tag Manager

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Landing Page Optimization

A/B Testing

Bid Strategy Optimization

Attribution Models

Microsoft Advertising (Bing)



This position is heavily focused on both Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.



You should understand the differences between the two platforms and know how to maximize performance on each rather than simply duplicating campaigns.



Meta Experience (Preferred)



Experience managing Meta 
 & Instagram) advertising is a significant advantage.



While our immediate focus is Google and Bing, we expect additional opportunities on Meta in the future.



What Makes Someone Successful Here



The ideal candidate:



Treats advertising dollars as if they were their own.

Watches campaign performance daily.

Identifies trends before they become problems.

Makes proactive adjustments—not reactive ones.

Bases decisions on data, not opinions.

Constantly tests new ideas.

Never becomes complacent.

Is highly analytical and detail-oriented.

Communicates clearly and transparently.

What We Don't Want



Please do not apply if:



You have only managed small campaigns for friends or local businesses.

You primarily build websites or do SEO and "also manage ads."

You outsource campaign management to others.

You rely on automated recommendations without understanding the underlying strategy.

You only review campaigns occasionally.

You cannot clearly explain why campaigns succeed or fail.

You are unable to provide real examples of measurable success.

To Apply



Please include:



Years of Google Ads experience

Years of Microsoft Advertising (Bing) experience

Current Google Ads certifications

Industries you've managed

Approximate monthly advertising budgets you've overseen

Your largest managed account

Examples of measurable performance improvements

Experience with GA4 and Google Tag Manager

Experience with Meta Ads (if applicable)



Finally, begin your application with the words:



"Data Drives Decisions."



This simple instruction helps us identify applicants who pay attention to detail.



If you're a seasoned PPC professional who thrives on optimizing campaigns, maximizing ROI, and continuously improving performance, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Closer — Warm Leads, No Cold Calling | $4/hr + Uncapped 3% Commission (Remote, PH)
description:
About us

We help small U.S. businesses — plumbers, roofers, HVAC, landscapers, auto shops — win more customers online. We build them a professional website from their own Google reviews and photos, and we set up their Google Business Profile for Maps. Here's what makes this easy to sell: for website prospects, the site is already built before we ever pitch it — the owner gets a free, finished preview to look at. Our appointment-setters do all the dialing and hand you owners who've already said "yes, I'm interested."



The role — closing, not cold calling

Every lead you work is warm: an owner who's already seen our work and raised their hand. No dialing strangers, no lists, no rejection grind. You pick up the conversation, figure out what the business needs, present the right offer, handle a few objections, and close. You'll work a queue of pre-qualified leads every day — and we coach you the whole way.



What you'll do



Work our warm-leads board daily — every interested owner and booked callback, teed up in one place.

Listen and recommend the right fit: a website, a Google Business Profile setup, or both. (Not every business needs both — matching the right solution is the skill, and combo deals earn you the most.)

Call interested owners back, re-establish the value, and ask for the sale.

Handle the common objections — price, "let me think about it," "my nephew can build one" — calmly and confidently. We train you on every one.

Present pricing cleanly: website ($700–$950 one-time + a small monthly hosting fee), Google Profile setup ($249), or both.

Send the agreement, secure the deposit, and log the outcome in our portal.



Who you are



You've sold over the phone and you enjoy the close, not just the conversation.

Confident, fluent English and easy rapport with U.S. small-business owners.

Calm with objections — you turn "maybe" into "yes" without being pushy.

Consultative — you listen and recommend what a business actually needs.

Organized and reliable — you follow up and keep your pipeline moving.

Coachable — you welcome call reviews and get sharper every week.

Reliable internet, a quiet space, and a headset; able to work U.S. business hours.

Bonus: experience selling to small businesses, home-services/trades, or web/marketing services.

What you'll earn



Uncapped 3% commission on every paid deal you close, plus a $4.00/hour base (clock in/out in our portal, paid weekly via Wise).

Every product is a deal: a website is a deal, a Google Profile setup is a deal, and an owner who buys both is two deals — so consultative closers who match the full solution earn more on the same call.

The leads are already interested. The more you close, the more you make — no ceiling.

Schedule



Start part-time (~10–15 hrs/week), with room to grow to more hours as you produce.

Hours overlap U.S. business hours (~9am–6pm ET/PT) so you can reach owners live.

100% remote. Paid weekly via Wise.



To apply

Tell us a little about your phone-sales experience — what you've sold, and a deal you're proud of. If you know your close rate, share it; if not, no problem. We read every reply.

title: Google Ads Account Manager
description:
About Us



We are a fast-growing digital marketing agency focused on helping car dealerships and automotive businesses generate more leads and sales through Google Ads. Our team specializes in Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, and AI-driven marketing strategies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Google Ads Account Manager who is organized, client-focused, and passionate about delivering exceptional campaign performance.



The Role



The Google Ads Account Manager will be responsible for managing Google Ads accounts, maintaining strong client relationships, and ensuring campaigns are optimized to achieve business goals. This role combines campaign management, strategic thinking, and client communication, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both the technical and relationship aspects of digital marketing.



You'll Be Working On:



- Google Ads Campaign Management – Building, optimizing, and maintaining Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Display, and YouTube campaigns to maximize performance.



- Campaign Optimization – Monitoring campaign performance, identifying opportunities for improvement, adjusting bidding strategies, refining targeting, and testing new ideas to improve results.



- Client Communication – Participating in client meetings, explaining campaign performance, answering questions, and providing strategic recommendations in a clear and professional manner.



- Reporting & Insights – Reviewing campaign data, identifying trends, and presenting actionable insights that help clients understand their advertising performance.



- Strategy Development – Collaborating with internal tea
mbers to develop advertising strategies that align with each client's goals, budget, and market.



- Account Monitoring – Proactively identifying issues such as tracking problems, disapproved ads, budget limitations, or declining performance before they impact results.



- Continuous Learning – Staying current with Google Ads updates, AI features, and industry best practices to continuously improve campaign performance.



What We're Looking For



- Experience managing Google Ads campaigns (agency experience is a plus).

- Strong understanding of Google Ads including Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Display, and YouTube campaigns.

- Familiarity with keyword research, bidding strategies, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization.

- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret performance data and make informed recommendations.

- Strong communication skills and confidence participating in client meetings.

- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously.

- Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving.



Nice to Have



- Experience with automotive marketing or local lead generation.

- Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager and Merchant Center

- Experience troubleshooting conversion tracking and website-related issues.

- Understanding of SEO and Meta Ads.



Compensation & Work Setup



- Competitive salary (based on experience).

- Remote-friendly role.

- Opportunities for professional growth and Google Ads certification.

- Work alongside an experienced digital marketing team serving automotive clients



Application Instructions



Please include a short 2–3 minute video introducing yourself. In your video, tell us about:



- Your experience managing Google Ads campaigns.

- A campaign or optimization you're proud of and why.

- How you approach optimizing an underperforming Google Ads account.



We're not looking for a polished production—just be yourself and let us see your communication style and passion for digital marketing.

title: Cold Outbound Specialist (Instantly.ai)
description:
Job Scorecard — Cold Outbound Specialist (Instantly.ai)



Mission



The purpose of this role is to run highly segmented, low-volume, high-specificity cold outbound campaigns across
 (Instantly.ai) and LinkedIn — generating qualified sales conversations through precision targeting and sharp, tested copywriting rather than mass-blast volume.



Outcomes



Qualified Conversations — KPI is number of qualified, booked calls generated from outbound, measured via Pipedrive, targeting a minimum of 3-5 qualified booked calls per week with steady growth as segmentation and copy improve. A booked call only counts toward this goal once our call closer has screened and confirmed it pre-call as a real client with a real budget — unqualified bookings and no-shows do not count, reviewed weekly.



Deliverability & Sender Health — KPI is inbox placement rate and spam complaint rate, measured via Instantly.ai, targeting consistently high inbox placement with minimal bounces/spam flags, reviewed weekly.



Segment & Copy Performance — KPI is reply rate and positive reply rate by segment, measured via Instantly.ai and Pipedrive, targeting steady improvement through ongoing testing, reviewed monthly.



Testing Velocity — KPI is number of A/B tests run on subject lines, copy, and sequences, measured via Instantly.ai campaign data, targeting continuous weekly testing (not "set and forget" campaigns), reviewed weekly.



Pipeline Accuracy — KPI is completeness and accuracy of CRM data, measured via Pipedrive audit, targeting 100% of leads and replies logged correctly, reviewed weekly.



LinkedIn Outbound Performance — KPI is connection acceptance rate and reply rate from LinkedIn outreach, measured via the LinkedIn automation tool, targeting steady conversion to booked calls, reviewed monthly.



Weekly Reporting & Testing Plan — KPI is a weekly report submitted on time containing A/B testing findings, spend, and booked calls, plus a new testing plan for the following week, measured via the weekly report itself, targeting 100% compliance — every single week has a report and a new testing plan, no exceptions, reviewed weekly.



Key Responsibilities





Lead Sourcing & Enrichment: Use Apollo (and similar tools) to build highly specific, well-researched prospect lists based on our ideal client profile — not broad, scraped lists.

Segmentation Strategy: Break lead lists into narrow, highly specific segments so messaging can be hyper-relevant rather than generic — this is a low-volume, high-precision approach, not spray-and-pray.

Campaign Copywriting & A/B Testing: Write and continuously test subject lines,
 copy, and sequences per segment, iterating based on real data.

Instantly.ai Campaign Management: Build, launch, and manage outbound
 campaigns and sequences in Instantly.ai; monitor deliverability and sender health closely.

LinkedIn Outbound & Automation: Set up and manage LinkedIn outreach/automation, making sure messaging aligns with
 campaigns and the automation actually works reliably.

CRM Management: Log and manage leads, replies, and pipeline stages accurately in Pipedrive.

Deliverability Management: Monitor domain/sender reputation, handle warm-up, and adjust sending practices to protect inbox placement.

Reporting: Report on outbound performance — reply rates, booked calls, segment performance — on a regular cadence.

Self-Sufficiency: Operate independently; proactively propose new segments, angles, and tests rather than waiting for direction.

Weekly Reporting: Submit a weekly report every single week, no exceptions, covering A/B testing findings, spend, and booked calls — plus a brand-new testing plan for the following week. There is no week without a fresh testing plan.





Key Competencies





Deep Instantly.ai Expertise (Required): Real, hands-on experience building and running high-deliverability outbound campaigns in Instantly.ai.

Pipedrive & Apollo Fluency (Required): Actual experience using these specific tools — not just similar CRM/sourcing tools.

Precision Segmentation Mindset: Understands that low-volume, high-specificity outbound outperforms spray-and-pray; can slice a list into meaningfully different, relevant segments.

Strong Copywriting: Writes sharp, specific cold
 copy that doesn't read like a template, and tests relentlessly to improve it.

LinkedIn Outbound & Automation Know-How: Comfortable setting up, running, and troubleshooting LinkedIn automation tools.

Deliverability Literacy: Understands sender reputation, domain warm-up, authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and how to stay out of spam folders.

Data-Driven Iteration: Comfortable reading open/reply/bounce rates and adjusting strategy in response.

Honesty: Only claims tool experience they actually have.





Tools Used



Instantly.ai (required), Pipedrive (required), Apollo (required), a LinkedIn outbound automation tool, Notion (daily activity tracking), Google Sheets, ClickUp and Slack (reporting & communication).



Job Description



Who We're Looking For



A cold outbound/growth expert who has actually run high-segmentation, low-volume outbound campaigns in Instantly.ai — this is not mass-blast
 marketing. You should already know Pipedrive and Apollo inside and out from real, hands-on use.



Full-Time Only: This is a full-time role. We are not considering candidates who are part-time or who work other clients on the side.



Remote Position: Fully remote.



Qualities: Precise, detail-obsessed, a sharp copywriter, a relentless tester, and honest about the tools they've actually used.



A Note on Required Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with Instantly.ai, Pipedrive, and Apollo is a hard requirement, not a preference. If you have never worked with these specific platforms, please do not apply.



A Note on AI Use in This Application: Don't use Claude or any other AI tool to answer the screening questions below — we want your actual answers, not AI's. If it looks AI-written, you're out.



Compensation



Base Salary: Full-time, commensurate with experience.



Performance Bonus: $25 per qualified booked call, paid out monthly on top of base salary. A call only earns the bonus once our call closer has screened and confirmed it, before the call happens, as a real client with a real budget — bookings that don't qualify, or no-shows, don't count. This means income scales with the quality of leads generated, not just the number of calls booked.



Responsibilities





Build highly specific prospect lists using Apollo, based on our ideal client profile.

Break lists into narrow, high-precision segments rather than broad, generic ones.

Write and A/B test
 copy and sequences for each segment.

Build, launch, and manage campaigns in Instantly.ai, monitoring deliverability closely.

Set up and manage LinkedIn outbound automation, aligned with
 messaging.

Keep Pipedrive accurate and up to date with leads, replies, and pipeline stage.

Protect deliverability through proper warm-up, authentication, and sending practices.

Report on outbound performance on a regular cadence.

Work independently; bring proactive testing ideas rather than waiting for direction.

Submit a weekly report, every single week with no exceptions, covering A/B testing results, spend, and booked calls, along with a new testing plan for the following week.





Daily & Weekly Rhythm



Every day:





Check Instantly.ai deliverability metrics (inbox placement, bounces, spam complaints) before scaling any sends.

Monitor and respond to new replies in Pipedrive, updating lead status the same day.

Log daily numbers in Notion —
s sent, opens, replies, and booked calls — so there's a live daily record, not just a weekly summary.

Work the LinkedIn outbound automation queue — connection requests, follow-ups, and replies.

Source and enrich new leads in Apollo to keep segment lists full and specific.





Every week:





Launch new A/B tests on subject lines, copy, or sequences based on the prior week's data — never running the same test twice with no changes.

Review segment and campaign performance (reply rate, positive reply rate, booked calls) and adjust targeting or messaging accordingly.

Sync with the call closer on which booked calls turned out qualified versus not, and use that feedback to sharpen segmentation and targeting.

Audit Pipedrive for data accuracy — every lead, reply, and stage logged correctly.

Submit the weekly report and next week's testing plan — no exceptions.





Experience





Proven experience running high-segmentation, low-volume cold
 outbound in Instantly.ai.

Hands-on experience with Pipedrive as a CRM — required.

Hands-on experience with Apollo for lead sourcing and enrichment — required.

Experience setting up and managing LinkedIn outbound automation.

A track record of cold
 copywriting and A/B testing results (reply rates, booked calls) you can speak to specifically.

Solid understanding of deliverability best practices — domain warm-up, authentication, sender reputation.





How We Will Help You Succeed





A clear ideal client profile and target account criteria to build segments from.

Access to existing brand messaging and positioning to ground your copywriting.

Room to test and iterate without being micromanaged.

A regular reporting rhythm so feedback happens on a set cadence, not constant oversight.

A dedicated call closer who screens and qualifies every booked call before it happens — so you can focus entirely on generating qualified conversations, not on closing them yourself.





Time Expectations



This is a full-time role, 40 hours/week, broken down as:





Lead sourcing & list segmentation (Apollo) — ~8 hrs/week

Campaign copywriting & A/B test setup — ~10 hrs/week

Instantly.ai campaign management & deliverability monitoring — ~8 hrs/week

LinkedIn outbound management & automation — ~6 hrs/week

CRM management (Pipedrive) — ~4 hrs/week

Weekly performance report & new testing plan (A/B results, spend, booked calls) — ~3 hrs/week

Internal meetings — ~1 hr/week





That totals 40 hrs/week.



Interview / Screening Questions



Note to Candidates: Answer these in your own words — no Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI. We can tell, and it'll disqualify you. Also: if you have not personally worked with Instantly.ai, Pipedrive, and Apollo, please do not apply — we verify this directly, and misrepresenting your experience will disqualify you immediately.





Walk us through a cold
 campaign you've built in Instantly.ai — how did you segment the list, and what results did you get (open rate, reply rate, positive reply rate)?

How do you approach segmentation — what makes a segment specific enough versus too broad?

Describe your process for A/B testing cold
 copy — what have you tested, and what actually moved the needle?

Walk us through your process in Apollo, from ideal client profile to a finished, enriched prospect list.

What's your experience with Pipedrive — how do you structure pipeline stages and keep data accurate?

How do you approach LinkedIn outbound — what automation tools have you used, and how do you keep that messaging aligned with
?

What do you do to protect deliverability — domain warm-up, authentication, sending limits — when running outbound campaigns?

Tell us about a campaign that underperformed. How did you diagnose why, and what did you change?

Can you confirm you're available full-time and not currently juggling other clients or part-time work?

Tell us about a time your outbound copy got called out as generic or spammy. What did you learn from it?

This role requires a report every single week, no exceptions, with a new testing plan every week. How do you personally stay disciplined about consistent reporting, and what would a typical weekly report from you actually look like?

Part of your pay is a bonus per qualified booked call — a call only counts once our call closer confirms pre-call that it's a real client with a real budget. How would knowing that change how you target and message versus just optimizing for booking volume?

title: Sr. Platform Engineer-PH
description:
About the Role



Pandoblox delivers enterprise-quality data platforms to mid-market companies in weeks, not months — a lean team amplified by AI. We're hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure the entire client-delivery pipeline runs on, and to evolve it so a small team can stand up and operate many concurrent, fully-isolated client environments without scaling headcount.





This is a senior IC role: ~70% hands-on platform/infra/DevOps, 20% architecture & security, 10% reliability. You live in Terraform, GCP IAM, CI/CD, and Cloud Run. The mandate isn't infrastructure for its own sake — it's infrastructure that gets client outcomes shipped faster, safer, and more repeatably.



This role goes deep on infrastructure, not up into the app layer. If you'd rather be shipping product features and UI, this is the wrong seat.



Responsibilities:



In this role you'll get to...



- execute and own the following:

   - IaC (signal-iac)— the Terraform/OpenTofu estate; provision a new client with a one-line flag flip. Every change is a PR with a plan diff; prod applies only through a gated workflow. Build the paved road so the delivery team onboards a client through a safe, gated path, not a ticket to you.

   - GCP multi-tenancy— a two-tier project model with one isolated project per client; physical, per-project isolation enforced by IAM.

   - Runtime isolation at scale— the shared services (signal-agents,signal-mcp, Supabase) serve every client at once, so one client's load can never degrade another: per-tenant quotas, fairness, noisy-neighbor protection.

   - Identity & secrets— the keyless model (Workload Identity Federation, impersonated service accounts). No long-lived keys, no secrets in Git, no path from laptop to prod.

   - CI/CD— GitHub Actions: build-once-promote, OIDC/keyless auth, trunk-based with environment promotion.

   - Observability & cost— SLOs, freshness/failure alerting, evidence-first i
 response, and per-client cost attribution so margin stays visible as clients stack up.

- collaborate with the project team 

- perform other duties or responsibilities  needed by the role



Requirements:



On day one, we'll expect you to...



- have 8+ years of platform / infra / DevOps / SRE, owning cloud architecture end-to-end

- have expertise in  Terraform / OpenTofu — production modules, multi-env, gated apply

- possess deep GCP — IAM & SA design, WIF, Cloud Run, networking, Secret Manager, BigQuery admin

- have strong CI/CD — GitHub Actions (or equivalent), OIDC/keyless, build-once-promote, trunk-based

- have expertise in security & identity judgment — keyless, least-privilege, gated-prod posture you own

- have experience in multi-tenant isolation at both the data and runtime tiers

- provide proactive observability & i
 response — alerting, SLOs, evidence-first debugging, on-call coverage

- be experienced in per-client cost attribution / FinOps instincts

- work with AWS alongside GCP (QuickSight reporting path, Secrets Manager)

- possess a delivery-first mindset: infra right-sized to delivery outcomes, not over-engineered

- have excellent written and verbal English communication skills

- have a fully functional and up-to-date computer with which to perform duties

- be willing to install next generation end point protection on the computer

- be a current resident of the Philippines and can perform work from there

- be willing to work within US Pacific timezone (8am - 5pm PST, 12AM - 9AM Manila time) or during client hours as required

- be willing to undergo a 90-days probationary period upon initial hire



Required Stack: Terraform/OpenTofu, GCP (Cloud Run, BigQuery, IAM, WIF, Secret Manager), GitHub Actions, Supabase, Vercel,  AWS (Quick, Secrets Manager), Claude (Anthropic API), and modern, opinionated, no legacy click-ops.



These are preferred experiences:



Multi-client/consulting delivery pipelines

- Supabase/Vercel ops

- AI-agent / LLM runtime infra (MCP, model APIs) 

- AI-augmented engineering workflows

Quality

Responsiveness

Proactivity

HOW TO APPLY

title: EXPERT Email Marketing Strategist
description:
Job Scorecard —
 Marketing Strategist



Mission



The purpose of this role is to own
 marketing strategy end-to-end for our client accounts — flows, segmentation, newsletters, and content calendar — bringing real, hands-on Klaviyo expertise to the table to drive measurable revenue from owned channels. This includes at least one account with 2M+
 subscribers, so this is not small-business
 — it requires genuinely advanced experience.



Outcomes



 Revenue Contribution — KPI is
's share of total attributable revenue, measured via Klaviyo analytics, targeting steady growth toward a strong owned-channel benchmark, reviewed monthly.



Flow Performance — KPI is automated flow conversion rate and revenue (welcome, abandon cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.), measured via Klaviyo flow analytics, targeting flows consistently converting above benchmark, reviewed monthly.



List Health & Segmentation — KPI is list growth, segment-level engagement, and deliverability/inbox placement, measured via Klaviyo, targeting strong deliverability with an active, evolving segmentation strategy, reviewed monthly.



Content Calendar Execution — KPI is newsletters sent on schedule, measured via the content calendar and Klaviyo campaign log, targeting 100% on-time sends with zero missed, reviewed weekly.



Strategic Reporting — KPI is strategy decks delivered, measured via the deliverable log, targeting one clear, data-backed strategy deck per client on an agreed cadence, reviewed monthly.



Key Responsibilities





Klaviyo Flow Strategy & Build: Design, build, and continuously optimize automated flows — welcome series, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, VIP, and more.

Segmentation Strategy: Build and maintain real behavioral and lifecycle-based segments — not just basic demographic splits.

Newsletter & Content Calendar: Own the
 content calendar end-to-end; plan and execute newsletter sends aligned with broader marketing and content strategy.

Strategy Decks: Build and present clear, data-backed
 strategy decks to clients — translating performance data into real recommendations, not just a recap of metrics.

Testing & Optimization: Continuously test subject lines, send times, content, and offers to improve performance.

Deliverability Management: Monitor sender reputation, list hygiene, and inbox placement.

Cross-Channel Alignment: Coordinate
 strategy with paid media and social calendars so messaging stays consistent across channels.

Self-Sufficiency: Operate independently and bring proactive strategic recommendations — this role should be teaching us things, not waiting to be told what to build.





Key Competencies





Deep, Verified Klaviyo Expertise: Non-negotiable. Must have real, hands-on experience building flows, segments, and campaigns in Klaviyo — not "familiar with."

Strategic Thinking: Can build a full
 strategy from scratch, not just execute a template someone else designed.

Data Fluency: Comfortable reading open rates, click rates, conversion rates, revenue per recipient, and deliverability metrics, and turning that into a clear recommendation.

Segmentation & Lifecycle Expertise: Understands how to map customer lifecycle stages to targeted messaging.

Content Judgment: Strong enough eye for copy and content quality to guide newsletter and flow content, even if not writing every word personally.

Presentation Skills: Can build and present a polished, confident strategy deck directly to a client.

Honesty & Integrity: Only claims platform experience they actually have — this is explicitly screened for in this hiring process.





Tools Used



Klaviyo (required), Canva or Google Slides (strategy decks), Google Sheets/Excel, ClickUp (task management & reporting), Slack (team communication).



Job Description



Who We're Looking For



An experienced
 Marketing Strategist with real, hands-on Klaviyo experience who can walk in with strong opinions on flows, segmentation, and content strategy from day one. This is not an entry-level role and not a "learn on the job" position — we need someone who already does this well.



Scale Note: We work with a client with 2M+
 subscribers. This is not a joke or a small-list side project — please do not apply if you are not genuinely advanced. Managing lists, segments, and deliverability at this scale is meaningfully harder than running
 for a small or mid-size brand, and we need someone who's actually done it.



Full-Time Only: This is a full-time role. We are not considering candidates who are part-time or who work other clients on the side.



Remote Position: Fully remote.



Qualities: Experienced, strategic, detail-oriented, a confident communicator who presents like a strategist rather than executes like a technician — and honest about what they actually know.



A Note on Klaviyo Experience: Hands-on Klaviyo experience is a hard requirement, not a preference. If you have not personally built flows, segments, and campaigns in Klaviyo, please do not apply. We verify this directly during the interview process (including a live walkthrough of a real account), and misrepresenting your experience will disqualify you immediately.



A Note on AI Use in This Application: Don't use Claude or any other AI tool to answer the screening questions below — we want your actual answers, not AI's. If it looks AI-written, you're out.



Responsibilities





Design, build, and continuously optimize Klaviyo flows (welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, VIP, etc.).

Build and maintain behavioral and lifecycle-based segmentation strategy.

Own the newsletter and content calendar end-to-end.

Build and present strategy decks with clear, data-backed recommendations to clients.

Run ongoing A/B tests on subject lines, send times, content, and offers.

Monitor deliverability, sender reputation, and list hygiene.

Coordinate with paid media and social calendars for consistent cross-channel messaging.

Work independently; bring proactive recommendations rather than waiting for direction.





Experience





Extensive, hands-on experience running Klaviyo for ecommerce or DTC brands — required, not preferred.

Experience managing large-scale lists (500K+ subscribers preferred, ideally into the millions) — segmentation complexity and deliverability management behave differently at this size, and we need someone who's actually operated at it, not just read about it.

A track record of building and optimizing high-performing
 flows, with real results to share.

Proven segmentation strategy experience — behavioral and lifecycle-based, not just basic list splits.

Experience owning a newsletter/content calendar end-to-end.

Experience building and presenting strategy decks to clients or stakeholders.

Strong grasp of
 marketing KPIs and how to translate data into strategy.

Ready to share a portfolio or case studies of past
 program results, with real numbers.





How We Will Help You Succeed





Established client relationships and existing brand/content assets to build from.

Room to bring and execute your own strategic point of view rather than follow a rigid template.

Clear reporting cadence so feedback happens on a regular rhythm, not constant oversight.

Collaboration with our Paid Media Manager and Social Media Manager for cross-channel alignment.





Time Expectations



This is a full-time role, 40 hours/week, broken down as:





Flow strategy, building & optimization — ~12 hrs/week

Segmentation strategy & list management — ~6 hrs/week

Newsletter & content calendar planning/execution — ~8 hrs/week

Strategy deck creation & client reporting — ~6 hrs/week

Testing & performance analysis — ~5 hrs/week

Internal & client meetings — ~3 hrs/week





That totals 40 hrs/week.



Interview / Screening Questions



Note to Candidates: Answer these in your own words — no Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI. We can tell, and it'll disqualify you. Also: if you have not personally built and managed campaigns in Klaviyo, please do not apply — we verify this directly, and misrepresenting your experience will disqualify you immediately.

How do you structure a content calendar for newsletters, and how do you d
 cadence and content mix?

Tell us about a strategy deck you've presented to a client — what was the core recommendation, and how did the client respond?

What's your process for diagnosing a drop in
 performance — open rates, deliverability, or revenue?

How do you approach A/B testing in
 — what have you tested, and what did you learn from it?

What Klaviyo features or integrations have you used beyond flows and campaigns (e.g., predictive analytics, custom properties, API integrations)?

Can you confirm you're available full-time and not currently juggling other clients or part-time work?

Tell me about a time your
 strategy recommendation was wrong. How did you find out, and what did you change?

What's the largest
 list you've personally managed, and what changed about your approach to segmentation, sending, or deliverability once it got to that size?

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
Purpose 



Scope 



Responsibilities 



Procedures  



4.1 Invoice Processing 



4.2 Payment Collection and Application 



4.3 Accounts Receivable Aging and Follow-Up 



4.4 Reconciliation and Adjustments 



4.5 Reporting and Financial Analysis 



4.6 Compliance and Internal Controls 



4.7 Risk Mitigation 



4.8 Customer Communication and Dispute Resolution 



Day-to-Day Activities 



Performance Metrics 



Reporting Structure 



Communication Channels 



Emergency Procedures 



Tools & Systems 



Review and Revision 



Sign-Off 



 



1. Purpose 



The purpose of this SOP is to define the roles, responsibilities, and procedures for the Accounts Receivable (AR) Specialist at DB Cleaning Services and its associated entities, it may include DBella Builders, DB Home Services, and DBC Properties. The AR Specialist is responsible for ensuring accurate invoicing, prompt collections, reconciliation of accounts, and maintaining positive customer relationships while ensuring compliance with company policies and financial regulations. 



 



2. Scope 



This SOP applies to all activities related to the accounts receivable function, including invoicing, payment collection, account reconciliation, financial reporting, and risk mitigation. The AR Specialist works closely with the Head of Accounts, Controller, and other finance tea
mbers to ensure smooth and efficient financial operations. 



 



3. Responsibilities 



The Accounts Receivable Specialist is responsible for: 



Invoice Processing: Generating and issuing invoices in a timely and accurate manner. 



Payment Collection and Application: Ensuring prompt collection and proper application of customer payments. 



Accounts Receivable Aging and Follow-Up: Monitoring overdue accounts and following up on outstanding balances. 



Reconciliation and Adjustments: Ensuring all payments are correctly recorded and reconciling discrepancies. 



Reporting and Financial Analysis: Preparing AR aging reports and providing insights on cash flow, P&L and others. 



Compliance and Internal Controls: Ensuring adherence to company policies and financial regulations. 



Risk Mitigation: Identifying and addressing potential risks related to non-payment or fraud. 



Customer Communication and Dispute Resolution: Managing customer inquiries and resolving billing disputes efficiently. 



 



4. Procedures 



4.1 Invoice Processing 



Frequency: Daily and as required. 



Process:  



Generate invoices based on completed services, ensuring accuracy in customer details, service descriptions, and pricing. 



Verify all invoices against service agreements and ensure proper approvals are obtained. 



Distribute invoices through
, customer portals, or postal mail based on customer preference. 



Maintain proper documentation of all issued invoices. 



 



4.2 Payment Collection and Application 



Frequency: Daily and weekly. 



Process:  



Monitor incoming payments through various channels (bank transfers, credit card payments, checks, ACH). 



Record and apply payments to corresponding invoices in the accounting system. 



Verify that payments match invoice amounts and investigate any discrepancies. 



Provide customers with payment confirmations and update internal records. 



 



4.3 Accounts Receivable Aging and Follow-Up 



Frequency: Weekly. 



Process:  



Generate and review AR aging reports to track overdue balances. 



Categorize outstanding invoices into 7-day, 15-day, 30-day, 60-day, 90-day, and 120+ day aging categories. 



Contact customers with overdue balances through phone calls,
s, and official notices. 



Escalate unresolved overdue accounts to the Head of Accounts for further action, such as collection agencies or legal proceedings. 



 



4.4 Reconciliation and Adjustments 



Frequency: Weekly and Monthly. 



Process:  



Reconcile customer accounts to ensure payment records match invoice records. 



Investigate and resolve discrepancies such as double payments, incorrect allocations, or missing invoices. 



Process credit memos, write-offs, or adjustments as necessary, following company policies. 



Ensure all adjustments are approved by the Head of Accounts before processing. 



 



4.5 Reporting and Financial Analysis 



Frequency: Weekly and Monthly. 



Process:  



Prepare weekly AR status reports highlighting overdue invoices, cash flow trends, and collection performance. 



Submit monthly reports to the Controller detailing outstanding balances, trends, and potential risks. 



Provide cash flow projections based on expected collections. 



Present variance analysis on collected vs. expected revenue and recommend corrective actions. 



Present week-to-week and month-to-month P&L analysis. 



 



4.6 Compliance and Internal Controls 



Frequency: Ongoing. 



Process:  



Ensure compliance with company policies on invoicing, payment collection, and dispute resolution. 



Adhere to GAAP and company accounting standards when recording AR transactions. 



Implement strong internal controls to prevent fraud, unauthorized discounts, or account manipulations. 



Work closely with external auditors during financial audits. 



 



4.7 Risk Mitigation 



Frequency: Ongoing monitoring and quarterly review. 



Process:  



Identify high-risk customers with a history of late or non-payment. 



Implement credit checks before extending payment terms to new customers. 



Establish payment plans for customers with financial difficulties, ensuring proper documentation. 



Report bad debts to the Controller and recommend further actions. 



 



4.8 Customer Communication and Dispute Resolution 



Frequency: Daily and as needed. 



Process:  



Respond to customer inquiries regarding invoices, payment status, and account balances. 



Investigate and resolve billing disputes within 48 hours to maintain positive customer relationships. 



Work with the sales and operations teams to clarify discrepancies in invoicing or service details. 



Document all customer interactions related to disputes and resolutions. 



 



5. Day-to-Day Activities 



Process invoices and ensure proper approvals. 



Monitor customer payments and update financial records. 



Follow up on overdue invoices and escalate as necessary. 



Reconcile accounts and resolve discrepancies. 



Communicate with customers to address inquiries and disputes. 



Prepare AR reports and provide financial insights to management. 



 



6. Performance Metrics 



Invoice Accuracy: Maintain error-free invoicing. 



AR Aging: Ensure 100% of receivables are collected within 30 days. 



Collection Efficiency: Minimize overdue accounts beyond 90 days. 



Dispute Resolution Time: Resolve 95% of disputes within 48 hours. 



Reconciliation Accuracy: Achieve 100% reconciliation with general ledger monthly. 



 



7. Reporting Structure 



Reports to: Head of Accounts. 



Coordinates with: Controller, sales team, operations team, and external auditors. 



 



8. Communication Channels 



Internal: Weekly updates with the Head of Accounts, coordination with finance and operations teams.

title: Mortgage Loan Processor — Remote Contract Position
description:
# Mortgage Loan Processor — Remote Contract Position



## About Shepherd Financial



Shepherd Financial is a full-service financial services company serving real estate investors nationwide. We specialize in private lending for distressed, value-add, and investment properties, including bridge, fix-and-flip, construction, and DSCR loans. We also support clients through our insurance and property disposition services.



## Position Overview



We are looking for an experienced remote mortgage loan processor to help manage loan files from initial application through closing. The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, comfortable communicating with borrowers and lenders, and able to manage multiple transactions with minimal supervision.



Experience processing private-money, business-purpose, construction, or fix-and-flip loans is strongly preferred.



## Responsibilities



* Review new loan submissions for accuracy and completeness

* Collect borrower, entity, property, and financial documentation

* Maintain organized digital loan files and processing checklists

* Submit complete loan packages to lenders

* Track outstanding conditions, deadlines, and closing requirements

* Follow up with borrowers, lenders, title companies, insurance agents, appraisers, and other parties

* Order or coordinate appraisals, title reports, insurance, and other third-party items

* Review entity documents, bank statements, credit reports, construction budgets, and borrower experience

* Assist with construction draw documentation when needed

* Provide borrowers with clear status updates

* Update the CRM and loan pipeline regularly

* Identify missing or inconsistent information before it delays underwriting

* Help move approved loans efficiently through closing



## Required Qualifications



* Several years of mortgage or loan-processing experience

* Strong understanding of the loan process from application through closing

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

* Reliable internet connection and availability during agreed-upon U.S. business hours

* Experience working with CRMs, spreadsheets,
, and digital document platforms

* Ability to handle confidential borrower and financial information professionally



## Preferred Experience



* Private-money or hard-money lending

* Business-purpose real estate loans

* Fix-and-flip and bridge financing

* Ground-up or renovation construction loans

* DSCR investment-property loans

* Construction budgets and draw requests

* Title, appraisal, insurance, and closing coordination

* GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Google Workspace, and DocuSign



## Compensation and Schedule



* **Starting rate:** $5 per hour

* **Position type:** Remote independent contractor

* **Initial schedule:** Part-time, with hours based on loan volume

* **Growth opportunity:** Potential for increased hours and responsibilities as the company and loan pipeline grow



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your total years of mortgage-processing experience

2. The types of loans you have processed

3. Any private-lending or construction-lending experience

4. The average number of loan files you have managed simultaneously

5. Your experience communicating with borrowers, lenders, title companies, and insurance agents

6. The loan-processing and CRM systems you have used

7. Your availability during U.S. business hours

8. Your desired hourly rate

9. A short explanation of how you keep multiple loan files organized

10. A brief video or voice introduction describing your relevant experience



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and may be given a brief sample loan-file exercise.

title: Creative Strategist for DTC Skincare — Own Your Creative Pod
description:
We’re expanding our creative team and are looking for a performance-focused Creative Strategist to own and operate an independent creative pod within élanora’s wider creative engine.



This role sits at the intersection of:

- Consumer psychology

- Creative strategy

- Direct-response advertising

- Copywriting

- Performance analysis



You will work closely with our Creative Operations Lead, Dutch Copywriter, creators, editors, designers and media buying team to develop concepts that drive both performance and long-term brand growth.





Your Mission



Your mission is to consistently discover, develop and produce new winning advertising concepts.



You will own your concepts from initial research until the final creative is ready to launch. You take full ownership.



You will be expected to:



- Find new consumer insights, angles and creative opportunities.

- Turn those insights into clear concepts, scripts and creator and editor briefings.

- Work with creators, editors and designers to bring your concepts to life.

- Review drafts and provide clear feedback on edits and content.

- Analyze performance and apply the learnings to future concepts.

- Help increase élanora’s creative hit rate over time.



Once fully onboarded, the target will be approximately: 40-50 new creative concepts per month.



Quality and commercial performance remain more important than producing volume without purpose.



Your Creative Pod



You will own an independent creative pod within élanora’s wider creative engine.



Your pod will include:



- You as the Creative Strategist

- A native Dutch Copywriter and Quality Checker

- Editors

- A Graphic Designer

- Access to our existing content and creative library

- Support from our Creative Operations Lead and founder.

- Performance feedback from our media buying team



Your pod will be evaluated through a clear scorecard based on:



- Quality of concepts

- Creative output

- Speed and reliability

- Number of validated winners

- Winner rate

- Commercial performance

- Ability to learn and improve



Strong performance can lead to increased capacity, responsibility and long-term growth within the creative department.



Responsibilities

- Creative Research

- Analyze winning and losing ads across Meta, TikTok and other platforms.

- Research competitors, adjacent brands and international markets.

- Study customer reviews, objections, motivations and buying triggers.

- Identify new angles, formats, hooks and creative opportunities.

- Turn research and performance data into actionable creative hypotheses.

- Concept Development

- Develop new advertising concepts and campaign angles.

- Write strong hooks, scripts, storylines and calls to action.

- Create detailed UGC briefings for creators.

- Create detailed editing briefings for editors.

- Create image-ad briefings for designers.

- Select the right existing assets for each concept.

- Develop multiple hooks and variations within concepts.

- Improve and iterate existing winning concepts.

- English and Dutch Concepts



English will be the master language of the creative system.



You will:

- Develop the complete concept in English.

- Write the English hooks, scripts and briefings.

- Create the first Dutch translation using our translation framework.

- Submit the English and Dutch versions together for review.



You do not need to speak Dutch. A native Dutch Copywriter will check and improve if needed.



However, your first translation should already be strong and complete. The Dutch Copywriter should optimize your work rather than rewrite everything from scratch.



The quality of the English concepts, scripts and briefings remains fully your responsibility.



- Creative Production

- Brief and manage editors and designers.

- Review the first versions of creatives.

- Give clear and actionable feedback.

- Ensure the creative follows the original strategy and briefing.

- Make sure all requested hooks, variations and formats are delivered.

- Continue managing the concept until it is ready for final approval.



Your responsibility does not end after writing the briefing. You own the quality of the final creative produced by your pod.



- Creative Performance Analysis

- Review creative performance data with the team.

Identify patterns behind winning and losing concepts.

- Understand which hooks, angles, formats and creators work best.

- Help determine which concepts should be scaled, iterated or discontinued.

- Translate performance insights into new concepts.

- Build a repeatable creative learning process within your pod.

- Develop messaging that feels persuasive without becoming aggressive or gimmicky.



What We’re Looking For

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Proven experience in creative strategy.

- Strong understanding of Meta advertising.

- Experience with DTC ecommerce brands.

- Strong direct-response copywriting skills.

- Excellent understanding of consumer psychology.

- Ability to identify patterns in creative performance.

- Strong commercial instinct.

- Experience writing scripts and creative briefs.

- Ability to manage editors, designers and creators.

- Highly organized and reliable.

- Comfortable working with clear output targets and deadlines.

- Able to work independently and take full ownership.



Bonus Points

- Beauty or skincare experience.

- Experience with female-focused consumer brands.

- Experience working across international markets.

- Experience managing a complete creative production process.

- Experience with Notion-based creative systems.

- Experience translating or localizing concepts for other markets.



What We Already Have



You will not be building everything from zero.



We already have:



- A Creative Operations Lead

- A native Dutch Copywriter and Quality Checker

- Editors and designers

- A media buying agency

- Existing winning ads

- A large content and asset library

- Creative workflows and SOPs

- A Notion-based creative system

- Product and customer research

- Historical creative performance data



Your role is to improve the quality of ideas entering the system and turn those ideas into a consistent flow of strong, testable creatives.



To Apply



Please start your application with the word “Collagen” so we know you have read the full job post.



Speak soon!

title: Graphic Designer — Book Design & Production
description:
About Table Eighteen

Table Eighteen produces luxury hardcover coffee table books that document beloved local restaurants through real

photography and storytelling. Each book is a bespoke, editorial-quality object — the kind of thing a restaurant owner is proud

to put on their host stand and their best customers want on their coffee table. We're a small, fast-moving team, and design is

at the center of what we sell.



The Role

We're looking for a graphic designer to own the visual production pipeline for our books — from cover concepts through

final print-ready files. You'll work closely with our founder on cover approval and with our production team on layout and

assets. This is a hands-on production role: strong software skills matter as much as taste.



What You'll Do

? Design book covers in Photoshop and Illustrator, and with AI image-generation tools, producing polished mockups

for owner and client approval

? Build out book maps (page-by-page layout plans) in collaboration with Claude, translating photo assets and story

content into a structured book flow

? Generate supplementary images with AI tools when original photography doesn't cover a needed shot

? Assemble final files in Adobe InDesign — typography, page layout, spine and dust jacket, print-ready output

? Keep every project consistent with T18's brand standards: editorial, lifestyle-forward photography treatment (no

harsh flash, no menu-photography look), a forest green and gold palette, and Cormorant Garamond / DM Sans

typography

? Turn around revisions quickly based on feedback from the founder and restaurant partners



What We're Looking For

? Strong working proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign

? Experience generating and refining images with AI tools (Midjourney, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, or similar)

? Comfortable using Claude (or similar AI tools) as part of a design/production workflow, not just as a novelty

? A portfolio that shows editorial, luxury, or lifestyle design sensibility — we care a lot about taste and restraint

? Reliable, self-directed, and communicative working async with a small remote team

? Strong English communication for feedback and revision loops



Nice to Have

? Print production experience — bleeds, spine width calculations, dust jackets

? Background in photo retouching or color grading (filmic, warm, true black-and-white)

? Prior experience on coffee table books, magazines, or other luxury print work

Details

? Type: Contract / freelance, remote

? Hours: Flexible, project-based deliverables with regular check-ins

? Reports to: Founder, Table Eighteen

your availability.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Job Scorecard — Appointment Setter



Mission



The purpose of the Appointment Setter role is to skillfully engage with potential clients through Instagram Direct Messages, persuading them to schedule consultation calls and highlighting the innovative services of [COMPANY].



Outcomes



High Engagement with Potential Clients — KPI is number of targeted conversations, measured via interaction logs, targeting 50 targeted conversations per day, reviewed daily.



Effective Appointment Setting — KPI is conversion rate to scheduled calls, measured via call scheduling logs, targeting a 30% conversion rate, reviewed daily.



Accurate Tracking and Reporting — KPI is completeness of EOD reports, measured via EOD form submissions, targeting 100% accurate logging, reviewed daily.



Continuous Skill Improvement — KPI is participation in training sessions, measured via training attendance records, targeting 100% attendance, reviewed bi-weekly.



Key Responsibilities





Identify potential clients based on customer personas.

Engage in effective communication and dialogues via Instagram Direct Messages.

Organize and track the progress of appointment setting using Instagram tags.

Maintain a structured approach to managing prospects in different sales stages.

Complete and submit a daily End of Day (EOD) form to track successes and habits.

Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams for cohesive messaging and strategies.

Actively participate in training sessions to enhance appointment setting skills.

Proficiency in using Instagram for business communication.

Organizational skills for managing and tracking interactions.

Attention to detail for accurate logging and reporting.

Ability to quickly adapt to new strategies and techniques.

Commitment to continuous learning and improvement.





Job Description

Full-Time Only: This is a full-time position — 8 hours a day, 5 days a week.



Remote Position: Fully remote.



Qualities: Proactive, persuasive, excellent communicator, high integrity, detail-oriented.



Compensation



Base Salary: $500/month, full-time (8 hours/day, 5 days/week).



Performance Bonus: $10 per qualified call booked that actually shows up for the consultation, paid out monthly alongside base salary. This rewards quality bookings, not just volume — someone who books fewer but stronger, better-qualified calls earns the same or more than someone who books a high volume of no-shows.



Responsibilities





Identify potential clients based on customer personas.

Engage in effective communication and dialogues via Instagram Direct Messages.

Tailor responses to prospects' needs, showcasing [COMPANY]'s solutions.

Quickly respond to DMs, maintaining a dynamic conversation with potential leads.

Organize and track the progress of appointment setting using Instagram tags.

Maintain a structured approach to managing prospects in different sales stages.

Complete and submit a daily End of Day (EOD) form to track successes and habits.

Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams for cohesive messaging and strategies.

Actively participate in training sessions to enhance appointment setting skills.

Stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and social media marketing techniques.





Experience





Proven experience in sales, marketing, or a similar role.

Proficiency in using social media platforms, particularly Instagram.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to build rapport and influence others.

Organizational skills for managing and tracking interactions.

Attention to detail for accurate logging and reporting.





How We Will Help You Succeed





Supportive Environment: Our team culture emphasizes collaboration, support, and constructive feedback to help you grow and excel in your role.

Professional Development: We provide opportunities for training and upskilling in the latest sales and social media techniques, keeping you at the forefront of the industry.

Cutting-Edge Tools: Access to state-of-the-art social media engagement tools to ensure you have the best resources at your disposal.

Regular Feedback and Evaluation: Constructive performance evaluations to help you understand your strengths and areas for improvement.

Work-Life Balance: As a remote position, we support a healthy work-life balance with flexible hours that fit your lifestyle.

Inclusive Culture: We celebrate diversity and encourage ideas and perspectives from all tea
mbers, fostering a creative and inclusive workplace.





Time Expectations



This is a full-time role, broken down as:





Engaging with potential clients — ~6 hours per day

Tracking and logging activities — ~1 hour per day

Preparing and submitting EOD reports — ~0.5 hour per day

Participating in training sessions — 2-3 hours bi-weekly

Internal meetings — 2-3 hours per week

Can you walk us through your experience with setting appointments via social media platforms?

Problem-Solving and Creativity

Technical Knowledge

Workflow and Time Management

Can you describe your workflow from identifying a potential client to scheduling a consultation call?





Communication and Teamwork





How do you handle feedback or criticism about your approach from clients or tea
mbers?

Adaptability and Learning

Tell us about a new skill or technique you recently learned and how you applied it in your work.

Shepherd Mortgage is a private lending and mortgage brokerage business focused on helping real estate investors secure financing for investment properties. Role Overview



This is a sales-focused virtual assistant role. Your main responsibility will be to make introductory outreach calls to real estate investors, ask about their current loan situation, and determine whether they may need help refinancing a loan that is coming due.



You will not be responsible for quoting detailed loan terms or structuring complex mortgage scenarios. Your job is to create conversations, qualify interest, gather basic information, and book follow-up calls with the loan advisor.

Identify interested prospects and schedule follow-up calls

Send basic follow-up
s and messages when needed

Update CRM records accurately after each call

Maintain a professional and conversational tone with U.S.-based real estate investors

Prior mortgage, real estate, lending, or financial services experience is required

Fluent, native-like English speaking and writing skills

Ability to work during U.S. business hours, at least partially

We are looking for someone who is confident, organized, reliable, and motivated by results.

20 hour trial run to start, with the opportunity to grow into a larger role.



Must overlap with some U.S. business hours.

Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.

title: Paid Media Manager / Analytics Expert
description:
Job Scorecard — Paid Media Manager



Mission

The purpose of this role is to run and scale paid media across our client accounts (typically $500K–$5M/month in ad spend) — hitting efficient cost-per-purchase and LTV:CAC targets, scaling budget without losing efficiency, and giving clients clear visibility into what's working and why.



Outcomes

Efficient Acquisition — KPI is Cost Per Purchase / CAC, measured via platform data plus an attribution tool, targeting meets-or-beats the client-specific CAC target, reviewed weekly.

Profitable Scaling — KPI is LTV:CAC ratio, measured via client data plus attribution tool, targeting 3:1 minimum and 4:1+ preferred blended, reviewed monthly.

Budget Pacing — KPI is spend vs. planned budget, measured via platform dashboards, targeting 100% of planned spend deployed with no under- or over-pacing, reviewed weekly.

Creative Velocity — KPI is new creative tested, measured via Ads Manager or a testing tracker, targeting fresh creative in rotation every week with no stale-ad fatigue, reviewed weekly.

Client Communication — KPI is reporting delivered, measured via ClickUp or a client reporting doc, targeting one performance report per client per week, on time, reviewed weekly.



Key Responsibilities



Channel Budget Allocation: Set and adjust spend splits across Meta, Google, and TikTok (and any test channels) based on real performance data, not a fixed formula.

Campaign Optimization: Monitor and optimize live campaigns daily — bids, audiences, placements, exclusions — to protect CAC as spend scales.

Creative Testing: Run a consistent testing cadence for new ad concepts/hooks; kill underperformers fast, scale winners deliberately.

Attribution & Reporting: Track cost-per-purchase, ROAS, and LTV:CAC per channel and per client; flag when a channel or campaign is bleeding money before it becomes a bigger problem.

Scaling Discipline: Know the difference between healthy scaling and just throwing more budget at diminishing returns.

Client Communication: Explain performance and recommendations in plain language — clients need to understand the "why," not just see a dashboard.

Self-Sufficiency: Operate independently day-to-day; flag issues or budget risks rather than needing routine oversight or approval.



Key Competencies



Platform Fluency: Deep hands-on experience in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads at minimum; TikTok Ads Manager a strong plus.

Numbers Literacy: Comfortable with CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, contribution margin — not just revenue-level metrics.

Judgment Under Ambiguity: Can read performance data and make a scaling/cutting call without waiting to be told what to do.

Creative Testing Rigor: Understands ad fatigue, frequency, and why testing velocity matters more than any single "perfect" ad.

Client-Facing Communication: Can translate performance data into a clear, non-jargon explanation for a client.

Autonomy: Can manage day-to-day budget and optimization decisions without needing regular check-ins or approvals.



Tools Used

Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, an attribution/analytics tool (e.g. Triple Whale, Northbeam, or platform-native), Google Sheets/Excel, ClickUp (reporting & task management), Slack (client + team communication).

Job Description

Who We're Looking For

A Paid Media Manager who's actually run ecommerce ad accounts at meaningful spend — not just managed a small budget for one brand. You should have real opinions on channel mix, CAC targets, and where money gets wasted, backed by actual experience, not theory.

Full-Time Only: This is a full-time role (40 hrs/week). We are not considering candidates who are part-time or who work other clients on the side.

Remote Position: Fully remote.

Qualities: Sharp with numbers, decisive, self-sufficient, and able to explain your reasoning clearly to a client who isn't a media buyer themselves.

A Note on AI Use in This Application: Don't use Claude or any other AI tool to answer the screening questions below — we want your actual answers, not AI's. If it looks AI-written, you're out.



Responsibilities



Set and adjust channel budget splits across Meta, Google, TikTok (and test channels) based on live performance.

Optimize active campaigns daily to protect and improve cost-per-purchase as spend scales.

Run ongoing creative testing and know when to kill vs. scale a concept.

Track and report CAC, ROAS, and LTV:CAC per channel and per client, weekly.

Flag underperforming spend or budget risk before it compounds.

Communicate performance and recommendations to clients in plain language.

Work independently; flag issues as they come up rather than waiting for review.



Experience



Proven experience managing paid media for ecommerce accounts at $500K+/month in spend.

Track record of hitting or improving CAC and LTV:CAC targets — be ready to talk numbers, not just describe process.

Deep hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads; TikTok Ads Manager a plus.

Experience with an attribution/analytics tool (Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar).

Comfortable presenting performance data directly to clients.



How We Will Help You Succeed



Established client relationships and account history to build from.

Clear reporting cadence so feedback happens weekly, not through constant oversight.

Access to creative production (video editing, design) so you're not blocked waiting on assets.

Room to make real budget and strategy calls — this isn't a "follow the playbook" role.



Time Expectations

This is a full-time role, 40 hours/week, broken down as:



Campaign monitoring & optimization (all channels) — ongoing, daily, highest priority — ~15 hrs/week

Budget allocation & pacing review — ~5 hrs/week

Creative testing setup & review — ~8 hrs/week

Attribution & performance reporting — ~6 hrs/week

Client communication — ~6 hrs/week



That totals 40 hrs/week.



Interview / Screening Questions

Note to Candidates: Answer these in your own words — no Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI. We can tell, and it'll disqualify you.



If you were handed a $1M/month ecommerce ad account today, how would you split budget across channels, and why? Where have you personally seen the most efficient cost-per-purchase across accounts you've run?

What LTV:CAC ratio do you consider healthy for ecommerce, and where have you actually seen accounts losing money vs. making money — be specific, not theoretical.

Walk me through a time you had to d
 whether to keep scaling a campaign or pull back. What data told you which way to go?

How do you approach creative testing — cadence, what you test for, when you kill an ad vs. let it keep running?

Describe a time a client pushed back on your recommendation. How did you handle it?

What's your process for catching a campaign that's quietly bleeding money before it shows up as a big problem in the monthly report?

Which attribution/analytics tools have you used, and how do you handle disagreements between platform-reported ROAS and what the attribution tool says?

Can you confirm you're available full-time and not currently juggling other clients or part-time work?

Tell me about the largest monthly ad spend account you've personally managed, and what your CAC/LTV results looked like.

How do you prefer to receive feedback — frequent check-ins, or comfortable working with occasional (weekly or bi-weekly) reviews?
