title: Care Coordinator
description:
OUR MISSION

Colure Health’s mission is to deliver reliable, patient?centered care that improves health outcomes through consistency, compassion, and disciplined operational excellence. We believe that if we can save one life, then the work is worth it. Every employee plays a role in building the systems, relationships, and trust that make high?quality longitudinal care possible.



ABOUT COLURE HEALTH & THE ROLE

Colure Health operates the Mozaiq Care+ platform and runs post-discharge care-continuity outreach for patients discharged from NYC Health + Hospitals facilities. The goal is simple: close the gap between hospital discharge and the patient’s next real appointment.



The Care Coordinator is a care-access closer, not a salesperson. Patients typically arrive already identified, verified, and enrolled by an Enrollment Specialist, so the Coordinator can move straight into the safety screen and scheduling conversation. Every completed, safe call ends with a booked PCP, specialist, or telehealth appointment, or a clearly owned same-day safety action — a pleasant conversation with no scheduled next step is not a successful call. This role supports U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours. Because the Philippines is roughly 12–13 hours ahead of ET, scheduled shifts fall overnight in Philippine local time; the legally required night-shift differential applies to hours worked between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM Philippine time.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Place outbound, post-discharge calls to patients recently discharged from NYC Health + Hospitals facilities (Bellevue, Elmhurst, Kings County, Lincoln, Metropolitan, and Woodhull), following Colure Health’s Care Continuity Outreach Playbook call flow: Verify – Safety – Reason – Path – Barrier – Close – Document.

• Verify patient identity (name and date of birth) and confirm permission before discussing care details with a caregiver or family member.

• Run the safety screen on every call to surface emergency or same-day clinical issues before scheduling; immediately direct patients to 911 or 988 and stop routine scheduling when a red-flag symptom is reported.

• Determine the correct follow-up pathway — PCP, specialist, telehealth fast-track, or same-day clinical escalation — and close every reachable, safe call with a booked appointment as the primary outcome.

• Identify and resolve real-time barriers to care (transportation, language, childcare, work conflicts, cost concerns, distrust) using the zero-barrier approach; no referral form or insurance question is used as a reason to delay scheduling.

• Offer immediate PCP assignment to patients who do not have, or have lost contact with, a primary care provider.

• Apply the Acknowledge – Reframe – Solve – Close objection-handling framework to move hesitant patients toward a scheduled next step.

• Receive each patient after an Enrollment Specialist has already reviewed the provider/discharge list, verified eligibility and insurance, obtained consent, and set the patient up in Mozaiq Care+ — using that completed intake to move straight into the safety screen and scheduling conversation instead of re-collecting information.

• Document every call outcome in Mozaiq Care+ using the required outcome code (appointment booked, next step assigned, unable to reach, refused, same-day escalation, or emergency escalation) along with barrier, urgency, owner, deadline, permission status, and next action.

• Adapt scripts for elderly, limited-English-proficiency, behavioral-health, and caregiver-involved patients, and for those enrolled in MLTC, FIDA, or PACE plans, using qualified interpreter support where needed.

• Meet quality and productivity standards measured against the Manager QA Scorecard (opening and trust, privacy and permission, safety screen, pathway accuracy, barrier resolution, conversion close, documentation, and role boundaries).

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent spoken and written English (C1 / near-native); Tagalog or another Philippine language is a plus but not required, since calls are conducted in English.

• High school diploma or equivalent; coursework or experience in healthcare, customer service, or call-center operations is a plus.

• 6+ months of experience in a contact-center, customer-service, healthcare-support, or patient-facing role.

• Comfortable following a structured call script while adapting naturally to real, sometimes difficult, patient conversations.

• Strong active listening, empathy, and de-escalation skills; able to stay calm with anxious, confused, or distrustful patients.

• Basic computer literacy and the ability to navigate a documentation platform (Mozaiq Care+) while talking with a patient.

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet distraction-free workspace, and equipment suitable for handling sensitive health information.

• Available to work scheduled shifts within the role’s Eastern Time (ET) operating window, including rotating evening or Saturday shifts.

• Able to pass a background check and complete HIPAA / PHI-handling training prior to taking live patient calls.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior experience in a healthcare, medical office, insurance, or care-management call-center environment.

• Familiarity with EHR, scheduling, or care-management platforms.

• Experience working U.S. healthcare accounts or supporting U.S.-based patients.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Appointment-booked rate — the primary metric: every safe, reachable call ends in a scheduled PCP, specialist, or telehealth visit, or a documented same-day safety action.

• Average Manager QA Scorecard score (100-point rubric covering opening/trust, privacy, safety screen, pathway accuracy, barrier resolution, conversion close, documentation, and role boundaries).

• Zero automatic-fail incidents: no medication advice given, no false reassurance, no missed red-flag symptom, no unauthorized PHI disclosure.

• Documentation completeness and accuracy in Mozaiq Care+ on every call.

WHAT COLURE HEALTH OFFERS

• Full paid training on the Care Continuity Outreach Playbook, safety-escalation protocols, and the Mozaiq Care+ platform before taking live calls.

• Remote, work-from-home role with a defined, consistent shift schedule.

• Ongoing call coaching and QA feedback from a dedicated supervisor.

• Career growth path within Colure Health’s care-management organization, including pathways into Enrollment Specialist and senior coordinator roles.



ROLE BOUNDARIES & COMPLIANCE



Care Coordinators are not clinicians.

Care Coordinators do not diagnose, clear symptoms, give medication advice, or tell a patient they are “fine.” Their job is to screen for safety, remove barriers, and get the patient to the right appointment or escalation — every call ends with a documented next step.

mbers regarding client progress.

mber or insurance agent.

Your role is to assist clients in completing their required enrollment paperwork and connect them with the appropriate representative when necessary.

 - 100–150 outbound calls per day per agent

Application Process

2. Video Introduction (2–3 Minutes)

There is no limit to the number of qualifying sales you can earn commission on.



Pay Schedule: Bi-weekly

Payment Method: PayPal only



This is a contract-based position.



Sales Performance Expectations



This is a performance-driven sales position. Contractors are expected to consistently develop their sales results and work toward established monthly goals.



Our current monthly performance levels are:



* 5 Sales – Minimum Requirement: Contractors must complete at least 5 qualifying sales per month to maintain the position.

* 10 Sales – Performance Standard: Established contractors are expected to consistently achieve at least 10 qualifying sales per month.

* 20 Sales – Monthly Target: Our target for each Sales & Appointment Specialist is 20 qualifying sales per month.

* 20+ Sales – Strong Performance: Contractors who consistently meet or exceed the monthly target will be recognized as strong performers and may be considered for additional opportunities and performance incentives as the program grows.



Performance is not measured by sales alone. Call activity, appointments scheduled, follow-up activity, attendance, documentation, customer interactions, and overall productivity will also be considered.



Falling below 5 qualifying sales in a month may result in termination of the contract.



Contractors who remain above the minimum but consistently perform below the expected standard may receive additional coaching and a performance improvement period.



The goal is not simply to maintain the minimum. We are looking for sales professionals who consistently work toward and exceed the monthly target.



Schedule



* 5 days on / 2 days off

* Working hours will fall between 10:00 AM and 7:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

* Exact working days may vary based on business needs

* Clock-in/clock-out tracking is required for payroll and attendance purposes



Reliable attendance and punctuality are required.



What We’re Looking For



This position requires someone who is already comfortable selling.



Ideal candidates should have:



* Strong previous sales experience

* Phone sales, telesales, outbound calling, call center, or appointment-setting experience

* Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation and strong conversational fluency

* Confidence speaking with U.S.-based customers

* Strong closing and objection-handling skills

* Ability to multitask and manage activity across multiple store locations

* Strong organization and follow-up habits

* Ability to work independently and remain accountable for results

* Reliable computer/laptop and high-speed internet

* Quality headset/microphone

* Quiet and professional calling environment



Experience selling technology, telecommunications, subscriptions, protection plans, insurance, or other service-based products is a plus.



Training



Training will be provided covering:



* Asurion Tech Care products and plan options

* Sales processes and expectations

* Appointment scheduling

* Customer follow-up procedures

* Systems and documentation

* Store operations and escalation procedures



We will provide the product and process training. We are looking for candidates who already bring the confidence, communication skills, work ethic, and sales mentality required to succeed.



How to Apply



Start your application with the words “TECH SALES.”



Please provide:



* Your current resume

* A brief description of your previous sales experience

* Any experience with outbound calling or appointment setting

* Any experience working with or selling to U.S.-based customers

* Confirmation that you can work between 10:00 AM–7:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

* Confirmation that you can receive payment through PayPal

* A 30–60 second voice recording



Voice Recording



Introduce yourself, briefly describe your sales experience, and tell us why you believe you would be successful selling technology services over the phone.



The recording should allow us to hear your natural communication style. No special equipment or professional recording is necessary.



Applications without both a resume and voice recording will not be considered.



Interview Process



Applications will be reviewed based on relevant experience, sales background, communication skills, and overall fit.



Selected applicants will be contacted for an interview as the next step in the hiring process.

title: Short Form Content Video Creator
description:
We are looking for a creative, dependable, and detail-oriented Short-Form Content Video Editor to produce engaging social media content for multiple client brands.



The primary focus of this role will be editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn and other digital platforms. You will work with raw footage, photography, brand assets, scripts, and creative direction provided by our team.



The ideal candidate understands that effective short-form content requires more than quick cuts and trendy transitions. Every edit should have a clear purpose, capture attention early, represent the client’s brand, and keep viewers interested through the final frame.



Because you will work with multiple clients, you must be able to move between different industries, audiences, visual styles, and brand personalities without making every video feel the same.



Key Responsibilities

Short-Form Video Editing



-Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.

-Turn raw video clips, photographs, voiceovers, and brand assets into polished, professional content.

-Create strong opening hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds.

-Use thoughtful pacing, visual variety, storytelling, and pattern changes to maintain viewer interest.

-Add accurate captions, music, sound effects, transitions, graphics, logos, and calls to action when appropriate.

-Edit videos in vertical, square, or horizontal formats based on the platform and assignment.

-Select the strongest 
nts from longer footage and repurpose them into concise social content.

-Occasionally assist with longer-form videos, interviews, testimonials, presentations, or promotional content.

-Export videos using the correct dimensions, resolution, file format, and quality settings for each platform.



Brand and Creative Execution



-Follow creative briefs, scripts, examples, and brand guidelines carefully.

-Adapt editing styles to reflect the personality and audience of each client.

-Create polished and aspirational content for hospitality, restaurant and professional-service brands.

-Maintain consistency in typography, colors, logos, captions, tone, music, and visual treatments.

-Recommend creative approaches when raw footage is limited or an assignment could be made more engaging.

-Identify clips, visuals, or information that may be missing before beginning an edit.



Workflow and Production



-Manage several video assignments across different client accounts and deadlines.

-Review each assignment carefully before beginning work and ask questions when instructions are unclear.

-Maintain organized project files, source footage, music, graphics, working files, and final exports.

-Follow established file-naming, folder-management, and version-control procedures.

-Provide editable project files when requested.

-Track assignment status and communicate promptly if missing assets, technical issues, or unclear direction may affect a deadline.

-Submit work on time and allow appropriate time for internal review.

-Complete revisions accurately based on feedback from tea
mbers or clients.

-Review every video before submission to catch spelling errors, caption mistakes, audio problems, awkward cuts, formatting issues, or incorrect brand elements.

-Maintain accurate daily timesheets by client and assignment.



What Success Looks Like



-Consistently deliver clean, engaging, brand-appropriate videos on schedule.

-Create content that feels specific to each client rather than relying on one editing style.

-Follow briefs and reference examples closely while still bringing creative ideas to the work.

-Catch small errors before a video reaches the internal review stage.

-Respond well to feedback and apply requested revisions accurately.

-Keep source files and final deliverables organized and easy for the team to locate.

-Communicate early when something is missing or a deadline may be at risk.

-Become a dependable creative resource the team can trust.



Required Skills and Experience



-Proven experience editing short-form content for social media.

-A portfolio that demonstrates strong pacing, storytelling, captions, sound design, and visual polish.

-Strong understanding of hooks, viewer retention, platform conventions, and current short-form editing styles.

-Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable professional editing software.

-Experience adding captions, music, sound effects, graphics, transitions, and basic motion graphics.

-Ability to edit from scripts, creative briefs, storyboards, and reference videos.

-Ability to match different brand styles rather than applying the same template to every assignment.

-Strong attention to spelling, punctuation, timing, alignment, audio quality, and visual consistency.

-Ability to receive feedback professionally and complete revisions accurately.

-Dependable communication and the ability to meet agreed-upon deadlines.

-Sufficient written and spoken English to understand creative direction and communicate clearly with the team.

-Reliable computer equipment, video-editing software, high-speed internet, and a professional remote-work environment.



Helpful but Not Required



-Experience editing content for hotels, travel, hospitality, restaurants, or lifestyle brands.

-Experience creating videos for businesses and agencies rather than only personal creators.

-Familiarity with Adobe After Effects or another motion-graphics platform.

-Ability to create simple animated text, graphics, maps, icons, or logo treatments.

-Experience editing interviews, testimonials, podcasts, case studies, or longer-form videos.

-Basic photo editing, color correction, audio cleanup, or thumbnail design skills.

-Experience working remotely with a U.S.-based agency or client team.

-Understanding of copyright-safe music, stock footage, and licensed digital assets.



You do not need to be an expert in every editing platform or technique. You do need to be creative, organized, responsive, and willing to learn how to create content for different client brands.



Working Arrangement

-Independent contractor position.

-Approximately 20 hours per week.

-Compensation is $5 USD per hour.

-Consistent weekly availability and dependable communication are required.

-Some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours is preferred.

-Work will be assigned and reviewed through the team’s project management and communication systems.

-This is intended to be a long-term working relationship for the right person.

-Additional responsibilities or hours may become available over time based on performance, workload, and mutual fit.



How to Apply

Please include the following with your application:

-Your resume or a brief summary of your relevant experience.

-A link to your video-editing portfolio.

-At least three examples of short-form videos you personally edited.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-ter
mber of our extended team. The right person will care about the details, respect each client’s brand, communicate reliably, and consistently turn raw materials into content worth watching.

Talking-head and interview videos

I use AI tools every day. That is why Claude experience is strongly recommended. But do NOT use AI to write your application. I can tell when AI wrote it, and I will delete it. Write your application yourself, in your own words. A short, honest application is better than a long AI one.



HOW TO APPLY



Send ALL of these:



Portfolio / IG links. Send your video work AND at least 2 examples of graphic design or photo retouching



Answers to these 3 questions (2 to 4 sentences each, in your own words):

a. How would you package and send me a Premiere Pro project so it opens on my computer with all the media files working? b. What do you use DaVinci Resolve for? When do you use it instead of Premiere?

title: AI-Native Staff Full-Stack Engineer (No training! Must be a pro)
description:
AI-Native Staff Full-Stack Engineer



Church Admin, Inc. · Full-time · Fully Remote · Reports to Engineering Manager



About Church Admin, Inc

Church Admin exists on a simple idea: what if churches partnered together and shared the business burden? We're a co-op that gives congregations access to professional-grade finance, HR, legal, and operations support — the kind of full-time expert staff most individual churches could never afford alone — by pooling resources across a fellowship of member churches.



We're Stronger Together. Join the fellowship, pay your dues, and get all the services: payroll and benefits, legal compliance, banking, insurance, and personal, ongoing support from real specialists — not a 9-to-5 call center. Our mission lets pastors, elders, and volunteer leaders spend less time on back-office administration and more time on ministry.



The Role

We're looking for an AI-Native Staff Full-Stack Engineer — a senior engineer who designs, plans, architects, reviews, and ships high-quality software fast by pairing deep engineering judgment with modern AI coding agents.



This isn't an "AI dabbler" role. You'll be a primary driver of how our team builds software: you architect systems and document the decisions behind them, you set and enforce our code review and quality bar, you own and evolve our CI/CD pipeline, and you curate the AI-assisted development workflows — prompts, agent playbooks, and review checkpoints — that let a small team ship like a much larger one, without sacrificing rigor.



What you'll own

Architecture & technical direction. Make and document key architectural decisions for our production application, and keep the codebase coherent as it grows.

Curating AI-assisted development workflows. Design and maintain the playbooks, prompts, and multi-step agent pipelines that our team uses to work alongside AI coding agents — including orchestrating longer-running, semi-autonomous agent runs and continuously improving how reliably those agents are steered and checked.

Code review & quality standards. Review code from both humans and AI agents with equal rigor. Verify before trusting. Set the bar for what "correct" and "done" mean on this team.

CI/CD ownership. Build and maintain a layered, efficient CI/CD pipeline — smart test selection, fast feedback loops, and reproducible dev/test environments — that keeps releases safe without slowing the team down.

Design & product conformance. Bring strong UI/UX judgment to reviews, and help maintain automated checks that keep our interface consistent with our design system.

Planning. Turn issues, specs, and product asks into clear, executable implementation plans that both engineers and AI agents can follow reliably.



What we're looking for

Required:



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field, or equivalent formal training in core CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, systems design). This role leans hard on fundamentals, and we screen for them directly.

5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Strong system design / architecture skills, and a track record of technical decision-making you can speak to in depth.

Solid CI/CD and test-automation experience.

A rigorous, evidence-based approach to code review.

Demonstrated, hands-on success shipping real work with AI coding agents/LLMs — this is a genuine requirement, not a nice-to-have. We want to see what you've actually built with them, not just that you've tried them.

Good design sensibility — a real eye for clean, usable UI/UX, beyond "does it work."

Professional-level written and verbal English — you'll communicate constantly with a fully-remote, English-speaking team.

A reliable remote work setup: stable high-speed internet and a performant workspace where you can do focused, uninterrupted, fast work.



Core stack (you should be comfortable working in these daily):



Python, Vue, TypeScript, and Cypress for automated UI testing.

Claude Code as our primary AI coding agent tooling. You don't need prior experience with Claude Code specifically, but you should already be fluent with some modern AI coding agent and ready to become an expert in ours quickly.



A strong plus:



Experience with the Frappe Framework — genuinely valuable, but not required. We'll get you up to speed.



Soft skills & how we work

This role is as much about judgment and communication as it is about code:



Detail-oriented. You catch the small things others miss, in code and in review.

Trustworthy with sensitive information. Our systems handle churches' payroll, HR, financial, and legal data. Discretion and integrity aren't optional here.

Written communication. You write clearly — documentation, review feedback, and technical decisions people can actually follow later.

Verbal communication. You can walk a teammate through a decision or an issue clearly and patiently in a remote, async-friendly environment.

Critical judgment. A healthy skepticism toward AI-generated output — you verify before you trust, and you catch plausible-but-wrong answers.

Autonomy & ownership. You're comfortable driving work to completion independently in a fully remote environment, without needing close supervision.

Teamwork, collaboration & mentorship. You raise the bar for everyone around you and work well with a small, tight-knit, mission-driven team.



Logistics

Employment type: Full-time

Location: Fully remote

Language: Professional-level English required

Remote setup: Reliable internet and a suitable home/remote workspace required



Mission & culture fit

Church Admin serves a community of Christian churches, and our mission is explicitly faith-centered. We don't require shared faith to do this job well, but genuine alignment with — or comfort and enthusiasm working within — a Christian mission is a real plus and part of what makes someone a great fit on this team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds who can do excellent work in service of that mission.

Our hiring process



We keep the process focused and respectful of your time, and it's designed around how we actually work — including with AI tools:



Application review. We read your resume and the note on something you've built with AI coding agents.

Technical assessment. A hands-on coding exercise covering our core stack. You're welcome and encouraged to use AI coding tools during it, just as you would on the job — we're evaluating how you work with them, not testing you in a vacuum.

Screening conversation. A short call to talk through your experience, working style, and fit.



How to apply

Interested? Send your resume and a short note about something meaningful you've built using AI coding agents.

title: Digital Marketing Executor (Content & Outreach Focus)
description:
Remote · Full-Time · Long-Term · Philippines-based · No Night Shift Needed



Who We Are



We’re EmployJoy.ai (employjoy.ai), an AI-native recruiting agency for US cleaning companies. Cleaning business owners tell us who they need. Our team and AI screen every applicant and send back a short list of pre-screened people ready to hire, usually in 3 to 9 days. Clients only fully pay if the hire is still working at 90 days. Cutting turnover is the whole point, because turnover is what costs cleaning companies the most.



Our founder ran a cleaning company for 17 years and made over 2,000 hires. He has a Wharton MBA, a #1 Amazon book on service-industry hiring, and is a ForHumanity Certified AI Auditor. The marketing strategy, the content calendar, and the brand voice guide are already built. That’s where you come in.



Who We Need



We need an experienced digital marketing executor. Not a trainee. Not someone starting from zero.

The strategy exists. The task list exists. The brand voice is documented. We need the person who executes it with discipline and proves it with numbers every week.



We live by the optimize — measure — learn cycle. Every project has a number. Every number gets tracked. Every result shapes what we do next. If that’s how you already work, keep reading.



Are You This Person?



(1) Accountable. You own your numbers. You don’t blame tools, the market, or the algorithm.

(2) Deadline-driven. You hit dates. When something slips, you flag it early.

(3) Data-first. You check dashboards before you share opinions.

(4) Measurement-minded. You think in baselines, targets, and deltas.

(5) Curious. You ask “what’s working?” and “why?” every week.

(6) Honest. You say when something isn’t working. No sugarcoating, no spin.



What You’ll Do



You’ll execute the marketing system that brings cleaning business owners into our pipeline — newsletter signups, Scorecard completions, and booked calls. Real projects, real numbers, real deadlines:



(1) Content engine (the core) — publish the weekly newsletter, 1 pillar blog every 3 weeks, 3 short videos, and 1 hero video each week. The founder records the raw video and provides outlines; you edit, caption, format, and publish in our documented brand voice.

(2) LinkedIn growth system — send 12 connection requests per day to target owners and partners; publish the weekly LinkedIn newsletter; run daily outreach to 3 connected targets and 3 profile viewers using our approved sequences; engage every day with our targets’ posts and comments. Our rule: add value first, promote second.

(3)
 (strict playbook) — 6 Page posts per week, including 3 videos. Participate in 3–5 vetted owner groups max: read every group’s rules, help-first comments only, low volume, no link-dropping, and the Scorecard is never posted in a group. You draft comments, send screenshots for the founder’s batch approval, then post.

(4) YouTube — publish 3 videos per week with titles, descriptions, and thumbnails.

(5) Lead magnet — promote the Cleaner Retention Scorecard and keep its funnel running end to end.

(6) Warm
 — run newsletter campaigns in MailerLite to leads who didn’t schedule and leads who scheduled but didn’t convert. All bulk
 goes through MailerLite, no exceptions.

(7) Cold
 — 2 nudge
s per week to our LinkedIn Sales Navigator target list. You may manage an outsourced provider for this instead of sending it all yourself.

(8) Referral program & conference marketing — prepare materials, track partners, and run follow-ups.

(9) Reporting — update the KPI dashboard weekly; flag what’s moving and what isn’t.

(10) Team support (startup flexibility) — we’re a small team, so when the week demands it, you help with admin, sales support, client service, and other tasks. Marketing is your core job, but nobody here says “that’s not my job.”



Website changes, sales calls, and client delivery are led by the founder and the rest of the team. You coordinate with them and jump in to support when asked — they own those areas; you keep marketing moving.



Every project has a goal. Every goal has a number. Every number gets reviewed.



Your Background



(1) 3+ years of real, hands-on digital marketing experience running content and social media for a business (coursework alone won’t cut it).

(2) Strong written English — short, clear, persuasive. You’ll write in the founder’s documented voice, and shortlisted candidates complete a short writing sample.

(3) Hands-on LinkedIn outreach experience. Sales Navigator experience is a plus.

(4) Basic video editing for short-form content (Descript) — cutting, captioning, and formatting for vertical video.

(5) Comfort with an
 platform (MailerLite or similar), GA4, and AI writing tools.

(6) A track record of setting goals, measuring results, and hitting targets.

(7) A 4-year Bachelor’s degree.

(8) Honesty about what you know and what you still need to learn.



Nice to have: B2B marketing and sales, LinkedIn marketing,
 marketing, and conference marketing.



How We Work (this is the deal)



(1) Daily async check-in (15 lines: what shipped yesterday, what ships today, blockers). We do not use surveillance or screen-monitoring software. We manage by visible output, not watched hours — your work must be visible: posts published,
s sent, videos live, dashboard updated.

(2) Weekly 1-hour Zoom with the founder to review the KPI dashboard.

(3) Schedule: a full-time engagement (about 40 hours/week of focused work) with 4 hours overlapping US Central mornings as a communication window.

(4) No graveyard shift: as only 4-hour overlapping, you do not need to work in graveyard shift.

(5) Dedicated, quiet workspace with reliable internet plus a backup for internet and power. This is a stay-in-place role — not a work-while-traveling role; nomad setups don’t deliver the reliability this position needs.

(6) Exclusivity: this is a full-time commitment — you won’t take on other clients while engaged with us.

(7) Company tools provided under a company
 we set up for you (MailerLite, AI writing tools, video tools, and the rest). You never use personal accounts for company work, with one deliberate exception:
 group participation runs through your own established personal account, under our written safety playbook, with every comment approved before posting.



Growth Path & Pay



This role has a clear growth ladder. As your measured results grow, your pay grows.



Level 1 (Intermediate) - $8/hour-equivalent

Level 2 (Intermediate plus) - $9/hour-equivalent

Level 3 (Advanced Specialist) - $10/hour-equivalent

Level 4 (Master Marketer) - $11/hour-equivalent

Level 5 (Authority Expert) - $12/hour-equivalent

Level 6 (Growth Partner) - $13/hour-equivalent

Level 7 (Marketing Leader) - $14/hour-equivalent

Level 8 (Marketing Leader) - $15/hour-equivalent



Because this role requires proven experience, qualified hires enter at Level 2–3 (a fixed monthly salary of roughly $1,440–$1,600) based on demonstrated skills. We pay a fixed monthly salary for the role and your availability window — not an hourly timesheet. From there we move people up based on measured results, not tenure. A modest quarterly bonus is tied to campaign outcomes (lead volume, Scorecard completions, booked calls); your base never depends on outcomes outside your control.



Benefits



(1) Company-paid AI tools built into everything we do

(2) Honest, ethical managers — direct support from the founder

(3) A documented training/onboarding program (you ramp in weeks, not months)

(4) A clear path to higher pay and more responsibility

(5) 6 paid US National Holidays

(6) 5 paid personal days in Year 1; 10 from Year 2

(7) No graveyard shift: as only 4-hour overlapping, you do not need to work in graveyard shift.



Our Culture & Values



(1) Direct, honest, empathetic communication

(2) Always learning — optimize, measure, learn

(3) Data-driven, not ego-driven

(4) Team connection — no one left isolated

(5) Integrity, every time



How We Hire



This role matters to us, so we take hiring seriously:



A short survey.

A small paid work sample (a short piece written in our brand voice from an outline we provide).

A video interview with a live screen-share of a content or outreach campaign you personally ran — show us the numbers.

A Zoom interview with the founder.

A paid 4-week trial at full salary, with real deliverables and clear, written acceptance criteria agreed before you start. We may run this trial with more than one candidate at the same time — if so, we’ll tell you openly, and everyone is paid in full. Pass the trial ? permanent, long-term role.



We’re looking for one person to grow with for years — not a contractor for a month.



How to apply? 



Include the words “AI Native” in the first line of your application. List 3 reasons why you are a good fit.



If you’ve read this far and you’re the disciplined, detail-driven executor we’re describing, we want to hear from you.

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
description:
DTiQ is looking for a hands-on Lead Full Stack Engineer to join our Drive-Thru engineering team in Melbourne.

Our Drive-Thru platform provides quick-service restaurant operators across the globe with real-time speed-of-service information and operational insights. The technology spans Angular applications, Java services, containers, Linux-based edge devices, IoT messaging, computer vision and cloud-connected systems.

This role goes beyond typical web development. It would suit a senior engineer who enjoys hands-on software development, solving complex technical problems and helping other engineers make sound technical decisions.

You will work across the full product stack, from user interfaces and backend services through to Linux devices, messaging and network communications.

What you will do

• Design and develop front-end applications using Angular and TypeScript.

• Build backend services, APIs and integrations using Java and Spring Boot.

• Develop and maintain software running on Linux-based edge devices.

• Implement communication between devices, applications and services using MQTT, REST APIs and event-driven patterns.

• Build, deploy and troubleshoot containerised applications using Docker.

• Investigate and resolve complex issues across applications, Linux systems, devices, messaging and networks.

• Lead the technical design and delivery of major product improvements.

• Review code and designs, mentor engineers and improve engineering practices.

• Improve system reliability, diagnostics, deployment and failure recovery.

• Work closely with Product, QA, Computer Vision, Support and Infrastructure teams.

What you will bring

Core requirements

• Strong commercial experience across front-end and backend software development.

• Strong experience with modern Angular, preferably Angular 17 or later.

• Strong TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS skills.

• Experience with standalone components, signals, reactive programming and state management.

• Strong commercial experience with Java and Spring Boot.

• Experience designing maintainable backend services, REST APIs, asynchronous processing and application integrations.

• Strong practical Linux skills, including shell scripting.

• Experience with Docker and containerised applications.

• Experience with MQTT or comparable messaging technologies.

• Sound networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, ports, routing and firewalls.

• Experience working with distributed systems, edge devices or intermittently connected environments.

• Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.

• Experience with Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Desirable experience

Experience in any of the following would be valuable:

• IoT or edge-computing platforms.

• Strong systems thinking.

• Virtual machines and virtualisation.

• Computer vision.

• Hardware or peripheral-device integration.

• Retail, hospitality or quick-service restaurant technology.

• AWS and hybrid edge-to-cloud environments.

• Monitoring, observability or configuration-management tools.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
We are a U.S.-based B2B industrial supply business looking for a graphic designer to support our ongoing e-commerce, marketing, and product documentation work.



1. Position Summary

We need a graphic designer who can produce clean, industrial-style visual assets across multiple formats — enhanced product content, e-commerce listing imagery, website imagery, packaging, labels, infographics, and product documentation.

Think 3M. Think Grainger. Think Uline. That is the visual register we work in: B2B industrial, utilitarian, spec-driven, durable-looking, function-first. Clean typography, technical illustration, performance claims front and center. This is not consumer retail — it is industrial supply.

That said, the design sensibility must be contemporary, not dated. We want modern industrial — the way the best B2B brands look today, not how a 1990s parts catalog looked. Visuals should feel current and relevant to today's working professionals — millennials and Gen X buyers in their 30s through 50s who are the actual decision-makers in industrial purchasing.

This is not a role for designers whose strongest work is lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wedding, or consumer-brand aesthetics. If your portfolio is built around pastels, soft-lifestyle photography, or "girly" branding, this is not your fit.

The right candidate is equally comfortable producing an enhanced content banner for an e-commerce listing and laying out a print-ready box label with regulatory text, lot numbers, and barcode placement.



2. Scope of Work

The designer will produce visual assets including:

Enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery (product detail page modules, brand store imagery, hero banners)

Website images and banners

Product labels and box label design (print-ready, with regulatory and barcode placement)

Box and packaging design

Infographics for product features, specifications, and application guides

Flyers, brochures, and sell sheets (digital and print)

Safety Data Sheet (SDS) formatting and layout support

Other ad-hoc graphic design work as needed



3. Required Skills & Experience

Proven portfolio of industrial, B2B, MRO, hardware, or technical product design — please include examples

Fluent in English — speaking, listening, and writing. You must be able to communicate effectively with us in real time, understand verbal direction clearly, and respond promptly in writing. This is non-negotiable.

A real creative streak and a contemporary design sensibility. Your work should look current and modern — industrial, but not dated. We need someone who brings ideas to the table, not someone who only applies templates. Designs must resonate with today's working-age buyers (roughly 30s through 50s), not feel like a relic from a previous generation.

Fluent with enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery requirements across major marketplaces (module structures, image specs, dimensions, file formats)

Experience designing print-ready files (labels, packaging, brochures) with attention to bleed, color profiles, and dieline accuracy

Strong typography and layout skills for dense, information-heavy content (specs, instructions, regulatory text)

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) or equivalent professional tools

Ability to follow brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency across assets



To apply, please send over your resume and portfolio.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced ecommerce operator to work directly with the founder of an established direct-to-consumer Shopify brand.



We've built a profitable direct-to-consumer wristwatch business through great products, exceptional customer service, and a loyal customer base. We've reached a stage where the next phase of growth requires an experienced operator who has successfully helped ecommerce businesses scale beyond their current stage.



As our Head of Ecommerce Growth & Operations, you'll serve as the founder's operator and strategic thought partner. Your mission is to accelerate the company's growth while making it increasingly less dependent on the founder's day-to-day involvement. You'll identify opportunities that improve revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, and the long-term strength and value of the business. You'll lead high-impact initiatives, improve systems, and help shape the company's next stage of growth.



Strategic Growth

- Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and growth opportunities across the business.

- Own high-impact initiatives from idea through execution.

- Research, validate, and implement new growth opportunities.

- Launch and optimize new products, partnerships, growth initiatives, and expansion opportunities.

- Continuously bring forward new ideas to strengthen the business over the long term.

- Turn strategic priorities into actionable execution plans and ensure they get completed.

- Monitor industry trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities worth pursuing.

- Balance growth opportunities with thoughtful decision-making to build a stronger, more resilient business.



Ecommerce & Operations

- Improve key ecommerce metrics including topline revenue, conversion rate (CR), average order value (AOV), customer lifetime value (LTV), retention, profitability, and customer experience.

- Continuously improve website performance, merchandising, customer journey, and operational workflows.

- Improve current customer service workflows.

- Improve reporting, dashboards, and business visibility.

- Improve supplier management, fulfillment, purchase order workflows, and internal operations.

- Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and technology to improve efficiency and scale.



Outcomes

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to create quantifiable impact, including:

- Increase revenue and profitability through high-impact business initiatives.

- Reduce the founder's involvement in day-to-day operations while maintaining or improving business performance.

- Build scalable systems, automation, and documentation that enable continued growth.

- Improve key ecommerce KPIs through continuous testing, optimization, and data-driven decision-making.

- Deliver strategic recommendations backed by thoughtful analysis and sound business judgment.

- Lead projects independently from planning through execution.



Technical Skills - Minimum Requirements

- Demonstrated experience working in a senior ecommerce, growth, or operations role within a successful Shopify brand, with direct ownership of initiatives that helped scale the business and produced measurable results.

- Strong understanding of ecommerce growth, operations, customer experience, and business analytics.

- Strong proficiency with Shopify and the broader ecommerce ecosystem.

- Experience leading cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify growth opportunities using data and business insights.

- Experience leveraging AI and modern technology to improve productivity, automate workflows, and scale ecommerce businesses.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Nice-to-Haves

- Experience launching new products or expanding product lines.

- Experience sourcing, managing, or coordinating contractors and external specialists when appropriate.

- Experience with modern ecommerce marketing, analytics, and automation platforms (e.g. Seguno/Klaviyo, Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, or similar tools).

- Experience with high-ticket or considered-purchase ecommerce products.

- Experience building dashboards, SOPs, and scalable operational systems.

- Experience using Shopify Flow, AI, or automation tools to improve business operations.



Non-Technical Skills

- Thinks like an owner—not just an employee.

- Strong business judgment and analytical thinking.

- Highly organized with exceptional project management skills.

- Naturally identifies opportunities for improvement.

title: Amazon & E-Commerce Marketing Strategist
description:
Reports To: Owner

Department: Amazon / E-Commerce / Marketing

Status: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday–Friday. Fixed PST hours strongly preferred (8:00 AM–4:00 PM or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST); 

candidates offering substantial daily overlap with PST business hours will also be considered.

Location: Remote



1. Position Summary

This is a senior, strategy-level marketing role — not an entry-level or trainee position. We are hiring someone who 

already knows how to research a target audience, position a product against competitors, and write listing and 

marketing content that converts, and who can own that work independently from day one.

The core of this role is marketing strategy and positioning: researching who a product's buyer actually is, what they're 

looking for, and how to frame a product so it wins against alternatives — then translating that thinking into listing 

copy, A+ content, and supporting marketing materials across Amazon and third-party marketplaces. Fluency with 

modern AI research and writing tools (Helium 10, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI imaging tools) is expected as 

part of how this work gets done efficiently — it supports the strategic and writing skill, it doesn't replace it.

The scope is expanding to include company social media — starting with LinkedIn — as a natural extension of the 

same audience-research and positioning skill set.

If you have not done audience research, competitive positioning, or marketing/listing writing before, this is not 

the role to learn on. We're looking for someone who can step in, take ownership of a product or listing, and run 

the strategy-to-execution process with minimal ramp-up.



2. Core Responsibilities



A. Marketing Strategy, Research & Positioning

• Research target audiences for each product — who the buyer is, what they're solving for, and how they evaluate 

options — and use that research to drive positioning decisions, not just describe the product.

• Conduct competitive research and analysis to identify how to position a product to win against named and 

unnamed alternatives on the market.

• Own the strategic framing for new product launches and listing rewrites: the angle, the audience, and the proof 

points, before a word of copy is written.

• Maintain and refine a repeatable research framework so positioning work is consistent and defensible across 

products.



B. Amazon & Third-Party Marketplace Listings

• Own listing creation end to end: research, positioning, listing copy, A+ content modules, and imagery, through to 

go-live.

• Build and maintain A+ content and image sets for existing products, including image optimization and content 

refresh projects.

• Extend listing presence to third-party marketplaces beyond Amazon, adapting content and positioning to each 

platform's requirements and audience.

• Own listing quality and category-placement work — resolving classification issues, closing keyword gaps, and 

running optimization passes on underperforming listings.



C. AI-Assisted Research & Content Tools

• Use Helium 10 as the core marketplace research and keyword tool for product and competitive research.

• Use AI assistants — Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity — as working tools for research synthesis, positioning 

exploration, and content drafting.

• Use AI or standard imaging/design tools to produce and optimize listing and A+ imagery.

• These tools support the underlying research, writing, and positioning skill — they are not a substitute for it.



D. Graphic Designer Coordination & Project Completion

• Serve as the primary coordination point with the graphic designer on all listing and A+ imagery — briefing the 

designer, setting expectations, and tracking delivery through to final, published assets.

• Own the completion of design-dependent listing projects end to end: confirm briefs are clear, review drafts against 

the positioning and audience research behind the listing, give focused revision feedback, and drive the project to 

done rather than leaving it open-ended.

• Proactively flag delivery timing risks or unclear briefs before they stall a listing launch.



E. Social Media & Content Strategy (Expanding Scope)

• Own the company's LinkedIn presence as the first phase of a broader social media function: content calendar, post 

drafting, and voice/brand consistency with marketplace listings.

• Apply the same audience-research and positioning approach used for listings to social content.

• Scope future expansion into additional social channels as the LinkedIn function matures, subject to approval.



F. Coordination & Documentation

• Route technical accuracy and specification questions to the relevant technical/product resource and confirm 

resolution before content goes live.

• Review marketplace customer feedback and advertising-related items relevant to listing content, and turn them 

into clear next steps.

• Maintain documentation tied to listings, such as standardized technical data sheet templates, in partnership with 

technical staff.



3. Authority & Decision Boundaries

This role MAY:

• Independently research, position, and draft listing and marketing content within brand guidelines.

• Select and use AI and research tools (Helium 10, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, imaging tools) to execute the work.

• Draft and post social content within an approved content strategy.

• Recommend tool subscriptions or upgrades with cost/benefit rationale for approval.

• Flag stalled projects, at-risk deadlines, or content/tool issues directly to leadership.



This role MAY NOT (without approval):

• Finalize brand voice, positioning, or creative direction on major launches or storefront redesigns.

• Approve advertising budgets, bidding, or campaign strategy.

• Commit to new paid tool subscriptions or vendor/contractor arrangements.

• Publish new social channels beyond the approved scope (currently LinkedIn) without sign-off.

• Approve refunds, returns, or customer concessions outside written policy.

When in doubt, escalate. Speed and clarity of escalation is valued over independent judgment on gray-area items.



4. Qualifications

This is a senior hire. We are not looking to train someone in audience research, positioning, or marketing 

writing from scratch — you should already do this well and be able to demonstrate it.

Required

• Fluent, native-level or near-native-level English, written and spoken. This is non-negotiable — the role is built on 

writing and positioning, and there is no room for translation gaps.

• Demonstrated, hands-on experience researching target audiences and positioning products or services against 

competitors — you can show work, not just describe the concept.

• Several years of hands-on experience writing and optimizing e-commerce marketplace listings (titles, bullets, A+ 

content) that you can point to and discuss.

• Working knowledge of Helium 10 or a comparable marketplace research/keyword tool.

• Practical, hands-on fluency with AI assistants for research and writing work — specifically Claude, Gemini, and 

Perplexity — and at least one AI or standard imaging/design tool for listing graphics.

• Comfortable owning a product or listing from research through published content with minimal oversight.

Preferred

• Prior experience managing a brand's LinkedIn or other social media presence.

• Experience listing on third-party marketplaces beyond Amazon.

• Exposure to industrial or B2B product categories.

• Solid understanding of SEO as it applies to marketplace listings and social content.



5. Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

• Independently research, position, and publish at least one new or rewritten listing with minimal direction.

• A clean, working coordination process with the graphic designer — clear briefs, tracked delivery, no listing 

project stalled waiting on unclear direction.

• A documented AI-assisted research and writing workflow in place and usable by others on the team.

• Helium 10 keyword and competitive research driving at least one measurable listing improvement (ranking, 

conversion, or category placement).

• Company LinkedIn presence launched with a documented content strategy and a regular posting cadence.

• Demonstrated ability to own listing and content decisions day-to-day without close oversight.



6. Reporting & Working Relationships

Reports To Owner

Primary Coordination Graphic Designer — daily/weekly coordination on listing 

and A+ imagery

Technical/Product Accuracy Technical/Product Specialist — chemistry, specs, TDS 

accuracy

Advertising & SEO Amazon Advertising & SEO Manager — coordination on 

keyword/SEO-related items



7. Schedule Requirements

• Full-time, Monday–Friday.

• Fixed PST schedule preferred: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST.

• Candidates unable to commit to a fixed PST schedule may still be considered if they can offer substantial daily 

overlap with PST business hours.



8. Compensation

• Competitive rate based on experience.

• Long-term, stable engagement with a defined growth path as the social media function expands.



Please send over your resume. Thanks
